published.source: DPS report 2026-10-31 (wowsimcli on this request, 20,000 iterations, seed 1, 180 ± 20 s; re-simmed on 2026-10-30 or 2026-10-31)

summary: Keeps Battle Shout up for its party. The raid's Battle Shout is off.
rotation: Pre-pull: Bloodrage and Battle Shout at -3s, then Battle Stance and Charge (15 Rage)
Recast Battle Shout with 35s left on it (about 142s in, before execute), unless its 3 min lasts the fight
Sunder Armor as the first GCD. Every warrior does this, and the tanks keep it up after
With 25s left, if Recklessness is ready and Rage is under 25, swap to Berserker Stance. Swap back after Recklessness
Recklessness in the last 25s. Racials on cooldown, but Elune's Light never during Recklessness or the 15s before it
Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, the second in the last 15s. Bloodrage under 20 Rage
Slam at 20+ Rage outside execute (15s cooldown with Improved Slam)
Overpower at 5+ Rage after a dodge or Bloodthrill
Keep Rend up outside execute. Then Execute
Heroic Strike at 90+ Rage and Hamstring filler at 10+, both outside execute
caveats: Assumed: white hits give Rage by weapon speed, at the level 30 rate even at level 60.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Heroic Strike stops at rank VIII, and the raid's Battle Shout at VI, Strength of Earth at IV and Grace of Air at II.
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is for white hits only. Heroic Strike can trigger Unbridled Wrath.
Only one +2% crit elixir. A second (Grizzly) would add 10.9 DPS.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece isn't counted. It would add 8.4 DPS vs Humanoids.
Booming Voice (5/5) does nothing, because the raid already has Battle Shout
Arms in Berserker Stance with Whirlwind is 10% behind.
Rage from taking raid damage (2 hits a minute, about 9 Rage each) is an estimate.
notes: Request from mksettings -spec arms -gear level60_phase1_synthetic_arms -apl level60_arms_battle_shout -talents 20305213032515201-55050000001 -race Undead -duration 180, then the raid's battleShout removed (standards 23: the duty preset's own shout is the only one). Not the class default: the warrior UI has one spec page and its default Level 60 build is Fury Dual Wield; this is the only Arms preset. Raid buffs, Kings and Might, debuffs, consumes, professions (Engineering, Alchemy) and the Level 60 encounter match ui/warrior/presets.ts. Undead since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29) (follows its base build, warrior__arms), was Orc.
